subject: Cross-country demo follow-up — model shortlist, locale prompts, and pilot actions
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ruiz <sofia.ruiz@velobank.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Cross-country demo follow-up — model shortlist, locale prompts, and pilot actions

Hi Sofia — thanks again for carving out time today. Quick recap and suggested next steps from our side so we have a single source of truth.

Summary of call
- Goal: evaluate candidate models for multilingual chatbot and document summarization across key EU + APAC markets (DE/FR/ES/PT-BR/JA/KO).
- Primary success criteria you shared: 1) accuracy on locale-specific terminology (banking/legal), 2) correct numeric formats/currencies, 3) tone control (formal vs. conversational per country), 4) privacy/GDPR-safe handling of PII.

Initial model shortlist (recommended for pilot)
- Mistral-Instruct-8B (quantized) — good instruction following and lower cost for short-form responses.
- Llama-3-13B (q4f16) — strong generalization on low-resource languages and good for translation-style prompts.
- Redwood-optimized-7B-mix (v2, int8) — tuned for latency in our EU region and available with KV-cache optimizations for multi-turn.

Benchmark links & artifacts
- Prompt sets and starter examples attached: velobank_prompt_pack_v1.jsonl (includes locale seeding, numeric edge cases, and masked PII examples).
- Baseline benchmark exports uploaded: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-velobank-benchmarks (see README for how to run locally).
- HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890 (deal RD-4781).

Quality/regression risks we should watch during pilot
- Diacritics and named-entity transliteration (German/Portuguese) can degrade with aggressive quantization — include orthography checks.
- Japanese/Korean tokenization differences may inflate latency for some families; try short sequence profiling.
- Numeric/currency formatting and localized punctuation: include seeded examples in the prompt pack.

Proposed next steps (timeline)
1) Internal: run a 48–72h benchmark across EU and APAC regions with the three model candidates using the attached prompt pack (action: Redwood eval team).
2) Customer: confirm target language priority and provide a sample corpus (anonymized) for domain-tuning tests.
3) Joint: kickoff pilot week of Nov 29 — run scoped acceptance tests and an SLA checkpoint.

Action items (owners)
- Neha: run regional benchmarks and share raw CSVs + short readout (48–72h).
- Marissa: coordinate pilot logistics and the mutual action plan / procurement touchpoints.
- Sofia/Carlos: share anonymized sample dataset and confirm priority markets by EOD Friday.

Attachments: velobank_prompt_pack_v1.jsonl (prompt seeds), pilot_mutual_action_plan.pdf (sample timeline).

Happy to jump on a quick 20m sync if you prefer to walk these items vs. email.

Best,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Sofia Ruiz <sofia.ruiz@velobank.com>

Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 12:35:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Cross-country demo follow-up — model shortlist, locale prompts, and pilot actions

Thanks Jonas — very thorough, appreciate the clarity. A few quick points from our side: 

1) Priority markets: DE and ES are highest, then PT-BR and FR. APAC is a secondary phase but we want JA and KO included in the pilot so we can understand tokenization/latency tradeoffs.
2) We will anonymize and send a ~500-document sample set by Friday (contains account statements and a few customer support transcripts). Any preferred format? CSV with a column for "locale" works for us.
3) Regarding models: can you clarify expected token costs for the three candidates and whether Redwood can pin specific model versions for the pilot? We need consistent outputs during our acceptance tests.

Two asks for the benchmark: please include a formal F1/Exact-Match for entity extraction (account numbers redacted) and a separate metric for currency/format correctness.

I can make time for a 20m sync Friday morning CET if that helps finalize the pilot scope.

Best,
Sofia Ruiz
Head of Digital Channels | VeloBank

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 13:05:00 -0800
Subject: FWD: Cross-country demo follow-up — model shortlist, locale prompts, and pilot actions

Neha / Marissa — forwarding Sofia's reply. Notes for the run: 
- Please run each model in both eu-central-1 and ap-northeast-1 to capture latency / token-cost deltas.
- For metrics, produce: EM (entity extraction), locale-format-accuracy (a small rule-based check), response-latency P50/P95, and a human-rated tone score (1–5) sampled per locale.
- Pin model versions and seed RNG where possible; we should supply the exact model artifact id in the readout.
- Budget: tentative 100k tokens per model-region combo for the pilot. Confirm if that is sufficient or we need to scale.

Runbook references: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-velobank-benchmarks (README has commands to re-run). HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890 (deal RD-4781).

Also flagging potential regression checks: diacritics test harness (DE/PT), currency formatting scripts, and a small suite for tokenization edge-cases in JA/KO. Make sure to include quantization debug logs for Llama-3 q4 runs.

Thanks — J

Hi Sofia / Jonas — quick status update and confirmed next steps.

1) Benchmarks: we kicked off the EU and APAC runs this morning for the three candidate models. Expected runtime ~36 hours; I'll share raw CSVs + a short synthesis doc as soon as the runs finish.
2) Model pinning: Redwood can pin model artifacts for the pilot. I will include artifact ids and exact quantization flags in the readout (example: llama3-13b-q4f16@v2026-11-17).
3) Token budget: 100k tokens per model/region is fine to start; if we see high variance on JA/KO we may scale an incremental 25k tokens for diagnostic runs.

Attachments and links included:
- velobank_benchmarks_drive_link.txt — direct access to the running logs and a temporary README.
- pilot_mutual_action_plan.pdf — updated with a tentative kickoff week of Nov 29 and roles clarified.

Sofia — please send the anonymized sample set (CSV with a locale column) and I'll ingest it into the eval harness. Also, we can do a short Friday 20m sync at 10:00 CET to lock the scope; sending a calendar invite now.

Cheers,
